oracle: checks before the spend (A22.4): a wrong PKCE verifier is refused without spending the code, which still exchanges afterwards
what: exchangeCode in functions/src/oauth/token.ts marks the code used in the same transaction that refuses a wrong verifier, so the right verifier then finds it spent

target.case: A22.4 redirects and PKCE: every token-endpoint check runs before the code is spent, so a wrong client, redirect_uri, resource or verifier is refused and the code still works; javascript:, data:, fragment and userinfo redirects are refused at registration and in a hand-built id; a loopback redirect matches any port, localhost is not 127.0.0.1, an https one matches exactly; only S256, and a failure once the redirect is known carries back with iss, which the consent page follows only when pressed

expect.message: the code still works after the refused attempts \(SPEC §23: a wrong verifier costs nothing\): 400 .*already used
